headline_marked: 3 [[Air Force personnel killed]] in crash at Dhaka airport's 3rd Terminal
headline: 3 Air Force personnel killed in crash at Dhaka airport's 3rd Terminal
summary: A pickup truck lost control and plunged from a flyover onto the second floor of the terminal, leaving three dead and four injured.
details: Three members of the Bangladesh Air Force were killed after their pickup truck lost control and plunged from a flyover at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport's Third Terminal.
The accident occurred around 10:20 PM on Monday, August 31, while the personnel were performing their regular duties.
The deceased have been identified as Warrant Officer Mahmud, Corporal Piyas, and LAC Zubaidul.
Four other Air Force members were injured in the crash and are receiving treatment.
According to the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), the vehicle fell from the flyover located on the second floor of the terminal.
The injured were immediately shifted to the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) in Dhaka for medical care, and the deceased were moved there for further procedures.

headline_marked: End of an era: [[Lionel Messi announces retirement]] from international football
headline: End of an era: Lionel Messi announces retirement from international football
summary: After 20 years with the Argentine national team, the football legend bids farewell in a deeply personal handwritten letter.
details: Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international football after two decades of representing Argentina. The captain shared his farewell through a personal, handwritten message spread across three pages of a simple notepad.

In his letter, Messi expressed that he has 'emptied' himself and has nothing left to give, thanking the fans for their love over the last 20 years. The message featured visible corrections and crossed-out words, reflecting a raw and natural tone.

His international journey was marked by extreme highs and lows, from early disappointments and heartbreaking finals to ultimate redemption. He led Argentina to victory in the 2021 Copa América and the 2022 World Cup in Qatar.

A striking detail in the announcement was a golden Harry Potter pen featuring a Time-Turner, used by the magical character Hermione Granger to travel through time. The pen sat beside the letter, adding a layer of symbolism to his reflections on the past.
Messi's career with the national team included 207 matches, scoring 125 goals and providing 68 assists. He retires as a world champion, having defeated France in a dramatic final in 2022.
The announcement follows Argentina's appearance in the 2026 World Cup final in East Rutherford, New Jersey, marking the final chapter of his legendary international career.
caption:
20 years, 207 matches, and a legacy that changed football forever. Lionel Messi says goodbye to the Argentine shirt.

Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international football after two decades of representing Argentina. The captain shared his farewell through a personal, handwritten message spread across three pages of a simple notepad.

In his letter, Messi expressed that he has 'emptied' himself and has nothing left to give, thanking the fans for their love over the last 20 years. The message featured visible corrections and crossed-out words, reflecting a raw and natural tone.

His international journey was marked by extreme highs and lows, from early disappointments and heartbreaking finals to ultimate redemption. He led Argentina to victory in the 2021 Copa América and the 2022 World Cup in Qatar.

A striking detail in the announcement was a golden Harry Potter pen featuring a Time-Turner, used by the magical character Hermione Granger to travel through time. The pen sat beside the letter, adding a layer of symbolism to his reflections on the past.

Messi's career with the national team included 207 matches, scoring 125 goals and providing 68 assists. He retires as a world champion, having defeated France in a dramatic final in 2022.

The announcement follows Argentina's appearance in the 2026 World Cup final in East Rutherford, New Jersey, marking the final chapter of his legendary international career.
